about: The address rule of mentions, one table for the service (app/service/src/agents/mentions.ts: ADDRESS_PATTERN, addressRanges, inAddress) and the web (app/web/src/data/mentions.js: the same), both of whose tests assert every case. 'pattern' is the pattern's source, character for character. Each case: a text; 'taken', the picked tags' ranges [start, end) in UTF-16 code units, whose own text is never read as an address (each character stands in as '_'); 'addresses', the address ranges expected; 'checks', [start, length, in an address] for a mention there: right after '/', or overlapping an address.

cases.note: a URL holds the @name in it
no scheme: no URL, but an @ right after / is an address
a link's target is an address, what follows it is not
a link's text is no address
a scheme glued to a digit is no URL (GFM does not link it either)
www. runs to the next white space, across Chinese punctuation
a URL runs to the next white space, across Chinese punctuation
an e-mail address is no URL
no // after the scheme: no URL; the / rule still holds
a picked tag's own text is never read as an address (a display name with www.)
the same text typed is an address
a picked display name with :// is no address
a URL running into a picked tag holds it: a real address position
www. right before a picked tag holds it
a picked tag right after / is in an address
a picked tag before :// is no scheme
